_about: Level-up perks (Phase 3). At each milestone the player picks 1 of 3. One offer targets the weakest area (power, supply, storage, speed); the others come from different categories. 'needsCap': only offered after the city power cap. 'once': never offered again after it is taken. {type}, {material} and {item} in text are filled in when offered.

list.name: Calm winds
list.text: Wind turbines no longer need empty space around them.

list.name: Free power
list.text: Every {type} uses no power at all.

list.name: Supply drop
list.text: A depot full of {amount} {item} arrives near the dock.

list.name: Free depot
list.text: Get a medium depot for free.

list.name: Bonus cut
list.text: Every 10th cut makes one extra half.

list.name: Discount
list.text: Solar panels and wind turbines cost 15% less.
